records.subject: Your Wrenfield subscription has been canceled
records.body:
Hi Aisha,

This confirms the cancellation of your Wrenfield plan. Sorry to see Lantern Studio go -- if there's feedback on what didn't work, I'd genuinely like to hear it.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: Lantern Studio canceled -- going to follow up to understand why

records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Aisha,

A reminder that your Wrenfield workspace is ready whenever you are -- creating one real project is the easiest way to see what it's for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Lantern Studio set up
records.body:
Hi Aisha,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no project, no invite, no tickets, and zero replies to two outreach emails [email:e264b7d0, email:a800ce7c]. Customer no-showed the scheduled onboarding call [calendar:f060f587], the strongest signal of low intent. Starter plan, solo admin. Unaided activation in the remaining 8 days is unlikely.

draft.subject: Still happy to help you get Lantern Studio started
draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

Sorry we missed each other on Monday — I know a new tool is easy to put off when the week gets busy.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one real project in place is usually all it takes for things to click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd rather do it solo.

Would a short call this week work to set up that first project together? Happy to work around your schedule.

Best,
Chidi
